Summary
The letter, written by Beckerman from Manila, Philippines, provides a detailed description of the office's location and surroundings. Beckerman mentions the Accounting Division's office, which was rebuilt after a fire, and describes the building as the "Human Life Insurance Bldg," which housed a significant pre-war insurance firm. The letter also includes a Christmas card and references to the office's location in relation to the city's geography. The tone is informative and nostalgic, reflecting on the office's history and the changes it has undergone.

--- Page 1 (Beckerman_100a) --- Dear Falks: I am sending you a few pictures to help [illegible] me! The two large photos are signal corps photos of our office; that is the Accounting Division. These were taken for Official War Dept. historical records but I managed to get hold of the enclosed copies. Photo No 2 shows "my" branch (which by the way extends off to the left of the picture). I placed a dot over my desk. With a magnifying glass you might even be able to read the name plate on my desk. Notice the number of Filipino civilian workers we have. The building remained standing because it was rebuilt but the troops that --- Page 2 (Beckerman_100b) --- interior was burned out when the [illegible] set fire to the city. Also enclosed as one of my own shots of the outside of the building. I marked the three floors that we occupy. The building is called the "Human Life Insurance Bldg" and housed one of the biggest pre- war insurance firms in the Orient. There's plenty of step-climbing without elevators. The top floor of the bldg houses the U.S. Army Manila Radio Station. It's about the highest spot in Manila and a wonderful view from the rooftop. No [illegible] me is enclosed --- Page 3 (Beckerman_100c) --- 3 with bamboo matting in place of glass. These are quite different from the photos & sent you of our Brisbane office. This paper by the way is a Christmas. Card printed in Manila. --- Page 4 (Beckerman_100d) --- Greetings FROM THE PHILIPPINES V-DAS 631 BAMBANG Manila
